status: Corrections to the v2 REVIEW, not to the raw run. out/real-batch-v2.json and out/real-batch-v2-raw.jsonl are unchanged; the review and the merged archive were re-generated with the corrections below.

items.what: Several v2 N6 reasons repeated the N5 regex result ('paraphrased, so the fact is not checkable') instead of judging what the text conveys.
items.effect: Under independent semantic judgement these texts DO convey the result: '将铜铃挂回原位' conveys that the bell was hung back; rain soaking the coat conveys the appearance change; '肩膀抵住了钟沿' conveys the second result. Their N6 verdicts therefore cannot rest on the regex miss.
items.fix: n5Formal lists N5 findings separately; N6 reasons are semantic only. Where a fact is conveyed, it is recorded as conveyed even though the formal frame still fails. Verdicts that remain 'fail' rest on other findings (missing move, invented content, truncation, format echo).

items.what: The v2 review was written against the first call but the archive did not say so, and the retry outputs were never reviewed.
items.effect: A reader could mistake the reviewed quality for the quality of the final output.
items.fix: Review records reviewedAttempt=1. The merged archive records reviewedAttempt per case, qualityPrimary (= reviewed attempt) and qualityFinal (pending whenever a retry exists, because its text was not reviewed). Summary reports both.

items.what: v2 reporting said the move fact was never stated, implying all 10 samples.
items.effect: Only 6 of the 10 samples carry a moved fact (rb-move-outcome, rb-time-vague, rb-two-actors-move, rb-same-name, rb-subtask, rb-move-other-appearance). The other four have no move to state.
items.fix: The movement statistic is reported over 6 samples (6/6 not conveyed in v2), and the sample list is recorded in the review summary.

restatedConclusion: Raising the output budget from 128 to 384 substantially reduced truncation (0/10 -> 8/10 first calls ending normally); the hard-gate pass rate is still zero.
